step_1_cost_table_from_cache.resource: MANA for Q/W/E/R; passive Transcendent has no cost

independent_computation.step_2_no_cost_modifier_in_kit: Searched every cached Syndra effect description and note for any mana-cost modifier. Transcendent RESTORES mana on splinter pickup (20 : 255 based on level) and W REFUNDS 10 mana only when throwing the Blue Sentinel; neither reduces a listed cost. No ability, no Transcendent bonus, and no note halves or scales a cast's mana cost. Therefore every cast_timeline entry's resource_cost must equal its own ability's tabled cost at its own rank -- there is no legitimate derived value between the table entries.
independent_computation.step_3_rank_state_implied_by_the_scenari: The scenario id ends in '120', which is Syndra's Splinters of Wrath cap ('stacking up to 120 times', Transcendent innate; 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%'). The cached passive says rank-ups grant '5 Splinters, up to 85' -- 85/5 = 17 rank-ups, i.e. all 17 skill points beyond the first, which is only reachable at level 18. So a 120-splinter Syndra is a fully-skilled level-18 Syndra: ranks Q5 / W5 / E5 / R3.

step_4_cost_set_attainable_in_this_scena.note: The only ability that costs exactly 50 in this rank state is E Scatter the Weak (flat 50 at every rank; Q only costs 50 at rank 3, which is impossible here). 100 is W at rank 5 or R at any rank.

independent_computation.step_5_which_ability_sits_at_cast_timeli: The scenario is a CUSTOM cast order (the engine's documented fallback order is the fixed Q,W,E,R -- see data/worklists/f2-task.md: 'src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)'). The rejected value 100.0 is exactly the cost of the ability the DEFAULT order puts at index 3 (R, 100 flat), while the accepted value 50.0 is the cost of an ability the default order never puts at index 3. That is the fingerprint of a per-cast cost being read against the default order instead of the order actually cast; under any custom permutation whose 4th cast is E, the correct cost is 50. Independent corroboration that the 4th slot is not R: at 120 splinters Q is charge-stocked ('Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2', corroborated by data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json listing 'stocked ability casts (... Syndra's Dark Sphere)'), so this scenario's rotation carries an extra Dark Sphere cast that displaces R past index 3 -- again leaving E (50) at the 4th slot. Both readings land on the same number.
independent_computation.arithmetic: resource_cost(cast_timeline[3]) = cost(E Scatter the Weak, rank 5) = 50 mana (flat, rank-independent). 100.0 is not a value E can take at any rank; it is R's / W5's cost, i.e. the wrong ability's entry.

residual_uncertainty: The golden scenario's explicit cast order lives in scripts/ and tests/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the identity of the 4th cast was deduced, not read. The deduction is: 50 is only producible by E (flat 50) in a level-18 / 120-splinter rank state, and 100 is only producible by R or W5 -- both are real costs, so the check is not a range check but an ability-attribution check. If the 4th cast were in fact R or W (rank 5), the old value would have been right. Every allowed line of evidence (default-order fingerprint of the 100, the extra stocked Dark Sphere cast at 120 splinters, and the repo's own precedent of R-first custom orders -- data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json records 'cast_order R,Q,W,E') points to E at index 3, so the new value is the defensible one.
